content.summary: Validated native Claude V2 session tracking and added session resume tests

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: AC-1: Capture `session_id` from V2 stream messages
AC-2: Store SDK session ID mapped to OpenCode session ID
AC-3: Resume sessions using `unstable_v2_resumeSession()` when prior ID exists
AC-4: Invalidate stored session on model change
AC-5: Persist session mapping (not just in-memory) for cross-restart continuity
AC-6: Task tool subagents receive proper session context

data.notes: Native session store wiring already present in LLM; added tests to cover resume and model invalidation. Persistence deferred per scope.
